meta.name: adversarial-stress-testing
meta.description: Campaign: Logical extreme and boundary testing via reductio ad absurdum and edge-case analysis. Core question: Does this artifact collapse under logical limits and boundary conditions? Methods: Lakatos 1976, Dutilh Novaes 2016, BVA, Flyvbjerg Critical Case, Popper.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用逻辑极限和边界条件检验工件是否崩溃
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对产品逻辑做极端压力测试
copy.tagline_en: Test artifacts for collapse under logical limits and boundary conditions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to stress-test product logic with extreme cases

howto.what: 分析用户提供的观点、假设或实验设计，通过逻辑极端和边界测试找出弱点，生成包含断点、有效性边界和改进后主张的AdversarialStressReport。
howto.when: 当用户提出主张、假设、研究问题、想法、方法或实验设计时触发，用于验证其逻辑极限和边界条件。

say.text: 测试这个假设：所有的天鹅都是白色的。
say.note: Claude会通过反例和边界分析来检验该假设。

say.text: 对我的新实验设计进行压力测试。
say.note: Claude会应用边界值分析和关键案例法来评估。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes user-provided claims, hypotheses, or experiment designs through logical extreme and boundary testing to identify weaknesses. Outputs an AdversarialStressReport with breakpoints, validity envelope, and refined claims.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user presents a claim, hypothesis, research question, idea, approach, or experiment design, typically for verifying its logical limits and boundary conditions.

say_en.text: Test this hypothesis: all swans are white.
say_en.note: Claude uses counterexamples and boundary analysis to examine it.

say_en.text: Stress test my new experiment design.
say_en.note: Claude applies boundary value analysis and critical case methodology.
